questions.text: What exact immutable release candidate, target set, dependencies, migrations, and exclusions are supported by evidence?
Which entry criteria remain unknown, contradicted, or unmet, and who owns each resolution outside this pack?
Which prespecified health, correctness, saturation, and user-impact signals prove or refute the release at each stage?
Is every conclusion compared with a digest-bound baseline and an explicit observation window?
What measurable trigger makes rollback eligible, and what evidence proves the trigger occurred?
Are state, data, compatibility, traffic, and dependency consequences of rollback known and supported?
Does the handoff preserve the ordered action, observation, decision, owner, and receipt ledger without inferring missing status?
Which release or incident facts remain unknown because authoritative evidence is unavailable?
